title: Customer Engineer, High Performance Computing (English)
descriptionHtml:
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

Specialist Customer Engineers seek to accelerate Google Cloud customer success by providing domain-specific technical expertise, while responsibly influencing products and solutions.

You will partner with technical Sales teams as a subject matter expert in High Performance Computing (HPC) to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will help prospective and existing customers and partners understand the power of Google Cloud, develop creative cloud solutions and architectures to solve their business challenges, engage in proofs of concepts, and troubleshoot any technical questions and roadblocks. You will use your expertise and presentation skills to engage with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.

You will be a part of a team of fellow Googlers working in an environment of respect where we promote equal opportunities to succeed.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive pre-sales technical strategy and build go-to-market solutions with customers and data center hosting partners to accelerate business cycles, resolve technical objections, and land large-scale Google Cloud TPU agreements and deployments across APAC.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor on end-to-end architecture and integration strategies across the TPU software stack and customer or partner environments (fleet management systems, job schedulers, IaaS operations tooling, ancillary storage/compute, and data center networking/WAN).

title: Data Center Technician, Global Data Center Server Operations
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g. Machine Learning platforms, network architecture).

title: Software Engineer III, Site Reliability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.

This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.

Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.

title: Design Verification Engineer, TPU, Silicon, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:

You will have an opportunity to drive TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, you will own the full verification life-cycle from verification planning and test execution to coverage closure, with an emphasis on meeting stringent AI/ML performance and accuracy goals, build constrained-random verification environments capable of exposing corner-case bugs and ensuring the reliability of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) workloads on Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) hardware. You will collaborate closely with design and verification engineers in active projects and perform verification.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Plan the verification of digital design blocks and interact with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
  • Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
  • Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
  • Measure to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
  • Create a constrained-random verification environment using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM).

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in verification, verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) or ASICs.
  • Experience verifying digital systems using standard IP components/interconnects (e.g., microprocessor cores, hierarchical memory subsystems).
  • Experience in verification and debug of IP/subsystem/SoCs in the networking domain such as packet processing, bandwidth management, congestion control.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Experience with industry-standard simulators, revision control systems, and regression systems.
  • Experience in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) accelerators or vector processing units.
  • Experience with the full verification life cycle.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

  • 3 years of experience in technical support for web technologies in a customer-facing role.
  • Experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Chrome Dev Tools, and working with APIs.
  • Experience in troubleshooting implementation issues, such as diagnosing critical product bugs affecting data flow.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Polish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technical field.
  • Experience setting up Enhanced Conversions (EC), Google Analytics (GA4), Consent Mode, and Tagging (including server-side tagging and API integrations).

title: Government Affairs and Public Policy Specialist (English, Spanish)
descriptionHtml:
As a member of Google’s Government Affairs and Public Policy team, you will engage externally and internally on behalf of Google. You will have strong investigative, organizational, and communication skills to manage multiple projects and respond to policy challenges effectively. You will be part of a global government affairs team, working across regions, product areas, and functions. You will combine creativity and intellectual excellence with the organizational skills to manage various campaigns, projects and initiatives.


In this role, you will advocate for Google to bring external perspectives back into the company to inform our perception and direction. You will be passionate about the opportunity to shape the future of how we use and build technology for everyone.

Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Legal, Marketing, Trust and Safety, and PR and other cross functional and business teams to integrate public policy priorities directly into product development and regional launches and execute local programs.
  • Represent Google before policymakers, industry peers, and key opinion formers to shape emerging dialogue on responsible technology policy.
  • Monitor, research, and analyze regional policy issues; design and execute comprehensive advocacy campaigns with clear, actionable goals.
  • Identify emerging legislative trends, evaluate their potential impact on Google’s users and business, and craft proactive solutions.
  • Support the development and execution of policy strategies in the country, working closely with more senior policy colleagues.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in policy analysis and campaigns, working on technology issues or the policy environments that surround them.
  • 4 years of experience working within government, think tanks, public interest groups, technology industry groups, or corporate public policy organizations.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Spanish fluently to engage with local stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Deep domain expertise and strong business acumen, with a proven ability to seamlessly integrate public policy with corporate business strategy.
  • Track record of leading and delivering cross-functional projects from inception to completion.
  • Experience in technology policy issues.
  • Strong and effective communicator and project manager.
  • Ability to operate in a changing, multi-stakeholder environment and exercise good judgment.

title: Technical Program Manager, Solutions
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.

Responsibilities

  • Own the execution roadmap for internal security tools, managing timelines, priorities, and engineering resource allocation across the software development lifecycle.
  • Ensure technical architectures from the Functional pod are translated accurately and efficiently into software builds by the operational pod.
  • Act as the primary technical liaison with central, managing security reviews, infrastructure dependencies, and compliance launch gates.
  • Triage engineering issues, evaluate design tradeoffs, and assess risk surfaces to prevent project bottlenecks.
  • Lead specific programmatic domains (e.g., data and access governance or remediation and response operations), ensuring holistic coverage of the gTech risk environment.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in technical program management.
  • Experience with central security infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise security, identity, or privacy programs.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, systems design, and technical risk management.
  • Experience in program management, generative AI agent, access models, insider threat, risk analysis, risk management compliance and identity management.

title: Data and AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

As a Strategic Cloud Data Engineer, you will guide customers on how to ingest, store, process, analyze, and explore/visualize data on the Google Cloud Platform. You will work on data migrations and modernization projects, and with customers to design large-scale data processing systems, develop data pipelines optimized for scaling, and troubleshoot potential platform/product challenges. You will have an in-depth understanding of data governance and security controls. You will travel to customer sites to deploy solutions and deliver workshops to educate and empower customers. Additionally, you will work closely with Product Management and Product Engineering teams to build and constantly drive excellence in our products.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Interact with stakeholders to translate complex customer requirements into recommendations for appropriate solution architectures and advisory  services.
  • Engage with technical leads, and partners to lead high velocity migration and modernisation to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Design, migrate/build and operationalise data storage and processing infrastructure using Cloud native products.
  • Develop and implement data quality and governance procedures to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data.
  • Take various project requirements and organize them into clear goals and objectives, and create a work breakdown structure to manage internal and external stakeholders.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in developing and troubleshooting data processing algorithms and software (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, Spark, Hadoop).
  • Experience building machine learning or data science solutions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in working with data warehouses, including data warehouse technical architectures, infrastructure components, ETL/ELT and reporting/analytic tools, environments, and data structures.
  • Experience in Big Data, information retrieval, data mining, or Machine Learning.
  • Experience in building multi-tier, high availability applications with modern technologies such as NoSQL, MongoDB, SparkML, and TensorFlow.
  • Understanding of database type, with the ability to write complex SQLs.
  • Understanding of distributed data processing frameworks and modern age GCP analytical and transactional data stores like BigQuery, CloudSQL, AlloyDB etc.
  • Understanding of core AI/ML concepts and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

title: Trưởng ngành hàng, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, thấu hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và chuyển hoá những nhu cầu đó thành các giải pháp hiệu quả, giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội ngũ bán hàng để cùng gặt hái thành công, góp phần định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo ra những tác động thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.


Khi đảm nhận vai trò này, bạn sẽ định hướng và dẫn dắt nhóm bán hàng và các phòng ban liên ngành để thúc đẩy một hệ sinh thái đang phát triển cho Google tại Việt Nam. Bạn sẽ cộng tác và phối hợp liên ngành, xuyên quốc gia để hợp thành một nhóm phụ trách từng khách hàng chiến lược trong ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, nhằm phát triển các mối quan hệ chiến lược, lâu dài và đôi bên cùng có lợi.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Xây dựng lộ trình, chiến lược và dẫn dắt đội ngũ triển khai hiệu quả nhằm khai phá trọn vẹn tiềm năng từ những khách hàng chiến lược hàng đầu. Thấu hiểu sâu sắc nhu cầu kinh doanh của các nhà quảng cáo trong ngành, đồng thời cung cấp thông tin chi tiết về hành vi tiêu dùng liên quan nhằm đưa ra những sáng kiến thúc đẩy tăng trưởng.
  • Tạo và triển khai các chiến lược tăng trưởng kinh doanh, kế hoạch hằng năm và kế hoạch phát triển khách hàng, cũng như quy trình kinh doanh cho ngành dọc mà mình phụ trách. Thiết lập và duy trì mối quan hệ chặt chẽ với các nhà quản lý cấp cao của các khách hàng và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu, đồng thời thúc đẩy việc ứng dụng các giải pháp của Google.
  • Xây dựng và quản lý một nhóm có thành tích cao để mang đến những giải pháp chuyên sâu, tập trung vào doanh nghiệp, đồng thời tạo dựng văn hoá đổi mới hoạt động kinh doanh và hướng tới sự thành công của khách hàng cho cả nhóm. Huấn luyện, khuyến khích, truyền cảm hứng và phát triển một nhóm gồm các Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Quản lý khách hàng chiến lược cũng như nguồn nhân lực phối hợp liên ngành.
  • Đại diện cho Google với vai trò là diễn giả chủ chốt tại các sự kiện trong ngành, phát triển thương hiệu của Google và xác định đối tác tiềm năng.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 11 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực bán giải pháp quảng cáo, tiếp thị kỹ thuật số, tư vấn hoặc truyền thông.
  • Có kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quản lý nhân viên.
  • Có khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để giao tiếp và phục vụ các bên liên quan trọng yếu.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm lãnh đạo nhóm bán hàng, quản lý các nhóm có thành tích cao, cũng như thúc đẩy tăng trưởng mang tính đột phá.
  • Kinh nghiệm quản lý và tác động đến ban lãnh đạo hoặc quản lý cấp cao thuộc phía khách hàng và các bên liên quan.
  • Kinh nghiệm xây dựng thương hiệu vững chắc và khả năng phối hợp cùng các đối tác nội bộ lẫn bên ngoài đến từ nhiều nền văn hoá và khu vực địa lý.
  • Kinh nghiệm lãnh đạo tư tưởng và tạo dựng các mối quan hệ uy tín cả trong nội bộ lẫn bên ngoài, cũng như khả năng tác động đến những quyết định trọng yếu và thúc đẩy sự đồng thuận về các ưu tiên chính.
  • Khả năng mang lại kết quả trong một tổ chức đa quốc gia theo mô hình ma trận.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Products and Systems, Google Photos
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

  • Design and own the 1-to-100 production backend systems needed to take successful experiments to 100M+ users without a full rewrite, covering async task execution, state streaming, data/byte permissions, and tool/MCP interfaces.

title: Product Manager, Location and Age
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Our mission is simple to state but exceptionally complex to execute: Enable Google and partners to easily provide compliant and appropriate experiences based on the user’s age and location.

At LASSO (Location and Age Signals and Solutions), we solve the challenge of providing digital experiences that are safe, legal, and age-appropriate for users across different global locations and demographics.

We build, optimize, and maintain the internal platforms that Google products like YouTube, Search, and Play rely on to understand user age and location. In a world where international laws are becoming more complex, our team ensures Google remains safe and trusted worldwide.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Architect central dashboards that translate pipeline latency and metrics modeling into business-critical compliance solutions.

title: Engineering Manager, Node Performance Team
descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

Operating at the critical boundary between frontier ML models and future accelerator roadmaps, you will build and automate cycle-level and analytical performance estimators to project throughput, latency SLOs, and Perf/TCO across different silicon configurations (SRAM/HBM hierarchies, multi-dimensional ICI interconnects, optical switching, and specialized compute engines like SparseCore). You will integrate LLM-driven agentic workflows to automate sweep generation, parameter exploration, data retrieval, and bottleneck diagnosis—accelerating hardware/software decisions.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable performance simulation frameworks to accurately evaluate training and serving metrics for next-generation TPU configurations.
  • Model how future model architectures (e.g., Mixture-of-Experts, multi-head latent attention, hybrid sequence parallelism, sparse attention, and KV-cache compression) interact with architectural variables (e.g., SRAM capacity/bandwidth, HBM contention, ICI network topologies, and live failover mechanisms).
  • Develop and integrate AI-agentic platforms and toolchains to automate simulator sweep setup, parameter sensitivity analyses, and data extraction over gigabytes of simulation sweeps—reducing analysis cycles from weeks to hours.
  • Build analytical and optimization engines (e.g., Mixed-Integer Programming/MIP, simulated annealing, roofline estimation) to identify Pareto-optimal execution strategies (sharding, tensor placement, weight pinning, prefetching).
  • Formulate clear, data-grounded performance projections and comparative studies (e.g., Iso-execution analysis, trade-off studies between compute density versus memory bandwidth) to inform multi-year TPU platform roadmaps and hardware contracts.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of software engineering (e.g., C++ and Python).
  • Experience with computer architecture concepts (memory hierarchies, roofline models, bandwidth versus compute bottlenecks, network topologies).

Preferred qualifications:

descriptionHtml:

Whether you're a patent attorney, an intellectual property expert or an engineer headed to law school, Google Legal lets you address unanswered legal quandaries and create new precedents. Our innovative services raise challenging questions that demand creative and practical answers. Our Platforms Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds the
hardware and software technologies that power all of Google's services. Our computational challenges are complex and unique, enabled by cutting-edge custom hardware designed and made in-house. As a hardware engineer, you will design and build the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. You will see those systems from concept all the way through to high-volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our cutting-edge data centers, affecting millions of Google users.

  • Experience with Linux/Unix and lab test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with data center optical transceiver standards.
  • Experience providing technical leadership to large cross-functional teams on complex optical technologies.
  • Understanding of wafer-level or chip-level probe testing or optical lab automation and scripting (e.g., Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW).

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Google DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
Google DeepMind brings together scientists, engineers, ethicists, and more to solve big challenges in artificial intelligence. Our goal is simple: Build AI responsibly to benefit humanity. We're known for leading research in areas like deep learning and generative models. As part of Google, we're working to build powerful AI that can solve real-world problems and spark innovation. The Finance team plays a key part in this, helping us make smart choices about where to invest our resources to keep the work moving forward.

As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will serve as a key finance business partner for Google DeepMind, driving strategic resource allocation, financial architecture, and long-term planning across our AI Product and Research portfolios. In this role, you will lead financial strategy across our commercial go-to-market initiatives and major compute infrastructure investments. You will partner with senior technical and product leadership to translate complex AI research and compute requirements into clear financial insights, influence strategic roadmaps, and build scalable financial models for sustainable growth.

You will collaborate closely with leaders building state-of-the-art AI models and products, navigating the financial nuances of training, inference, and infrastructure scaling. You will proactively advise stakeholders on investment trade-offs, maximize compute Return on Investment (ROI), and lead cross-functional alignment across global time zones (including central Google Finance, California-based, and London-based leadership).

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $141000 - $205000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Product and Research leadership to guide long-term financial strategy, budget planning, and capital allocation, driving compute and infrastructure ROI optimization.
  • Lead advanced financial modeling and scenario planning to evaluate the cost implications of technical, infrastructure, and go-to-market trade-offs.
  • Design, establish, and scale financial frameworks, governance models, and automated forecasting processes to improve accuracy, transparency, and operational efficiency.
  • Synthesize and communicate complex financial, technical, and operational narratives to product leads, research Directors, and central Google Finance leadership.
  • Cultivate collaborative partnerships across cross-functional organizations, including Technical Infrastructure, Corporate Finance, Commercialization, and Google DeepMind leadership to streamline strategic planning.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), consulting, or a related function.
  • Experience executing full-cycle FP&A functions including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and modeling within a multinational company setting.
  • Experience with SQL and Generative AI.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working directly with Product, Research and Development teams in Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning (AI/ML).
  • Experience building detailed financial models to track and evaluate return on investments.
  • Experience working with large datasets using SQL and SAP financial data systems.
  • Experience using Generative AI tools in a professional environment.

title: Product Manager, Google Health Guardian
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The Google Health team is building products and services that empower our consumers to live a longer, healthier life. We do this by building the best of Google’s technologies and foundational AI models into consumer experiences focused on health and wellness, which are intuitive, credible, actionable and deeply personal, helping users understand their health and support them in taking proactive actions to improve their long-term health.

As a Product Manager, you will be pivotal in scaling Health Guardian, our longitudinal and proactive health solution, by bridging cutting-edge physiological AI research with high-reliability health data pipelines, clinical validation workflows, and launch-ready consumer health features.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive strategy to scale up health data integration for the Google Health app to enable more personalized and helpful Health Coach experiences.
  • Enable scaling of the Health Guardian feature integration with Google Health coach, to help users understand their health and get personalized recommendations for next steps.
  • Shephard core health guardian features and drive new novel development to expand Health Guardian features.
  • Lead the product strategy and execution for longitudinal data collection efforts to support novel health discovery, including leading large scale research study, designing thoughtful and engaging user experiences to ensure high quality data collection.
  • Partner with other Product Managers and cross-functional teams to accelerate validation speed while upholding rigorous clinical, legal, privacy, and safety guardrails.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.
  • Experience in product management, with a focus on building consumer app platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant technical or health field.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, with strong technical, analytical, and collaboration skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and balance resources across teams, while ensuring milestones are met on time and with high quality.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts and drive alignment across various stakeholders (Product Managers, Researchers, Engineers, and Raters).
  • Demonstrated success in solving ambiguous problems, challenging the status quo, and creating innovative, successful consumer-facing products.

title: Global Product Lead, Support Tools, Global Business Applied AI, GTM
descriptionHtml:
gTech’s Product and Tools Operations team (gPTO) leverages deep user, operational, and technical insights to innovate Google's Ads products into customer experiences that are so intuitive (or automated) that they require no support at all. gPTO partners closely with gTech’s Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Engineering teams to innovate and simplify our Ads products and build the productivity tools ecosystem for gTech users.

GTM’s Global Business Applied AI (GBAI) team leverages deep user, operational, and technical insights to innovate Google's Ads products into customer experiences that are so intuitive (or automated) that they require no support at all. We partner closely with gTech’s Support and Services, Product Management, and Engineering teams to simplify our Ads products, build the productivity tools ecosystem, and develop AI solutions for gTech users. We are leaders of the customer experience, advocating for big-picture visions, feature requests, and offering product improvements backed by data-driven insights. Our work enables gTech teams to deliver delightful services to our customers and sellers.

As a Global Product Lead you will work directly with Product Management (PM), Engineering, and User Experience (UX) to design, develop and launch capabilities, and improvements for servicing customers. You will represent the Ads Service organizations, translating their needs into requirements. In this role, you will contribute analytical and communication skills to join a fast-paced team, and work cross-functionally with key partners across gTech, Sales, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, and UX.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand key customer and business team needs related to gTech anchor tools.
  • Set the direction and strategy for Sales and Services platforms and tools, identify strategic solutions, and influence technical roadmap. Manage the delivery, performance, and user satisfaction of anchor tool components and features.
  • Ensure transparency around systems development, providing key information to communicate and educate the business on capabilities and investments.
  • Articulate prioritized business needs to the Product Management team and influence their roadmap to address them.
  • Lead Applied AI Solutions for Ads Support.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience in product or program management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience gathering, interpreting, and presenting data to identify business needs and propose solutions.
  • Experience creating and delivering presentations at the executive level, along with scoping, managing and delivering projects.
  • Knowledge of global customer service operations, support platforms, the online advertising industry, and Google Ads.
  • Understanding of applications for Artificial Intelligence and Applied AI.
  • Ability to influence others, fostering and maintaining key relationships over time. Ability to adapt quickly and work in a fast-changing environment.
  • Interest in improving customer experience, strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

title: Technical Program Manager, Energy Asset Delivery and Management (Thai, English)
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

At Google, our infrastructure is core to our global mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful. To power this infrastructure, we are committed to meeting our energy needs sustainably, reliably, and efficiently.

In this role you will be responsible for tracking, reporting and risk mitigating the delivery of mission critical power generation and power infrastructure assets that will power Google's mission critical data centers. You will be responsible for tracking and reporting on project schedules, variances to schedule, and take any and all steps, including contract negotiations and amendments, to ensure delivery of critical infrastructure that is as on time and on budget as possible. You will intake projects from the commercial structuring team and track them until successful delivery. You will have responsibility for power supply for a set of data centers within a region and oversee consultants as necessary while also working closely with internal partner teams ranging from engineering to supply chain to real estate to construction, finance and legal.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end delivery and oversight of third-party power asset development for Google data centers across Thailand, Southeast Asia, and APAC.
  • Collaborate closely with utilities, transmission owners, and developers to ensure projects meet strict delivery timelines, control budgets, and negotiate contract amendments.
  • Coordinate cross-functional internal teams including engineering, construction, and capacity planners to ensure smooth handoffs and proactively mitigate project risks.
  • Partner with portfolio management to develop standardized tracking tools, databases, and data governance frameworks that clearly communicate portfolio status.
  • Maintain accurate planning data, track and report plan variances, and implement corrective measures to guarantee on-time asset delivery from all counterparties.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program or technical project and portfolio management of energy infrastructure.
  • Experience with contract negotiation with power infrastructure and supply.
  • Ability to communicate in Thai and English fluently to support vendor and contractor management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Experience in asset delivery and asset management across the energy industry.

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Game, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người đặt nền móng cho đà tăng trưởng có chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, giành chiến thắng nhờ giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động để chứng minh sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác.

Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ là đối tác chiến lược và cố vấn đáng tin cậy cho các nhà phát triển trò chơi và ứng dụng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam, giúp họ mở rộng quy mô và thành công trên trường quốc tế. Bạn sẽ quản lý và thắt chặt các mối quan hệ ở cấp điều hành, định hình cách Google hỗ trợ hệ sinh thái tăng trưởng mạnh mẽ này trên toàn cầu.

Nhiệm vụ cốt lõi của bạn là thúc đẩy tăng trưởng kinh doanh cho khách hàng bằng cách tận dụng Chiến dịch quảng cáo ứng dụng và Hệ sinh thái ứng dụng của Google, đồng thời khai thác các cơ hội đổi mới giữa các sản phẩm để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh vượt trội và có thể đo lường.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Tương tác và tạo sức ảnh hưởng đến những người ra quyết định chủ chốt, bao gồm cả ban lãnh đạo cấp cao, xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy để thấu hiểu các thách thức cốt lõi và ưu tiên chiến lược trong hoạt động kinh doanh của họ.
  • Dẫn dắt quá trình phát triển kế hoạch kinh doanh chung, thống nhất với khách hàng về các mục tiêu đầy tham vọng và xác lập trách nhiệm chung để mở ra các cơ hội tăng trưởng mang tính đột phá.
  • Thiết kế và thuyết trình về các giải pháp mạnh mẽ, dựa trên dữ liệu của Google được điều chỉnh theo nhu cầu của khách hàng, tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và cách kể chuyện lôi cuốn, đồng thời xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều để thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh số.
  • Thể hiện rõ giá trị của Google bằng cách đối chiếu kết quả chiến dịch so với mục tiêu của khách hàng và giải pháp của đối thủ cạnh tranh, đồng thời chia sẻ thông tin chi tiết dựa trên dữ liệu để định hình chiến lược của khách hàng và củng cố mối quan hệ đối tác.
  • Chịu trách nhiệm thúc đẩy đà tăng trưởng của khách hàng bằng cách chủ động xác định và phát triển nguồn cơ hội mới dồi dào, tận dụng thông tin chi tiết và thành công đã được chứng minh để mở rộng mối quan hệ đối tác.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo kỹ thuật số, tư vấn bán hàng, phát triển kinh doanh hoặc tiếp thị kỹ thuật số.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để phục vụ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong ngành trò chơi/ứng dụng, truyền thông, phát triển kinh doanh, tiếp thị hoặc tư vấn bán hàng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm và đạt được thành công trong việc phát triển và duy trì những khách hàng được quản lý có giá trị cao, phức tạp theo hướng chiến lược thông qua phương pháp tư vấn.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Có khả năng vận dụng những cách tiếp cận sáng tạo để phát triển giải pháp qua dữ liệu.
  • Có kỹ năng tổ chức, giải quyết vấn đề, tạo sự ảnh hưởng và thuyết trình xuất sắc.

title: New Business Sales BS/MS Intern, 2027 (Multiple Languages)
descriptionHtml:
The New Business Sales team partners with businesses in all shapes, sizes and market caps, and no one Google advertising solution works for all. Their knowledge of online media combined with their communication skills and analytical abilities shapes how new and existing business grow. Using influencing and relationship-building skills, New Business Sales teams provide Google-caliber client service, research and market analysis. They anticipate how decisions are made, persistently explore and uncover the business needs of Google's key clients and understand how our range of product offerings can grow their business. Working with them, they set the vision and the strategy for how their advertising can reach thousands of users.

Business Development Consultants in Google Customer Solutions help clients develop national and international marketing strategies. In this role, their mission is to cultivate and develop relationships with new businesses, helping them to grow and to develop their digital marketing strategy. Business Development Consultants build and manage a pipeline of clients working towards strategic objectives and be responsible for collaborating with a number of internal stakeholders to maximize the long-term success of these new customers and partners.

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Cloud Storage, AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Storage Staff Software Engineer in the datapath team, you will design and implement advanced storage solutions tailored for AI/ML workloads on Google Cloud Platform. You will address complex system design challenges, develop production-ready code, and contribute to fast-paced incubation projects. Your role involves developing benchmarks, resolving performance issues and collaborating with cross-functional teams to bridge storage infrastructure with evolving AI/ML demands, from training to inference.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement high-complexity features, delivering robust, production-ready code for storage solutions that address the specific demands of AI/ML workloads.
  • Architect scalable and performant storage solutions, driving the technical design for features and making data-driven decisions to optimize system efficiency and reliability.
  • Adapt to fast-paced development cycles for new technical domains.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and intricate system issues, developing innovative, practical solutions to technical challenges that arise at the intersection of storage and machine learning.
  • Partner with product and engineering stakeholders across the storage domain to deliver high-complexity features and products.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience developing performance oriented storage solutions, including datapath modules.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience in software development, and with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization including technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional or cross-business projects.

title: Data Center Server Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we aim to foster Googley work environments that are collaborative, friendly and fun. The Facilities Management team brings our spaces to life as you oversee the daily operations of our offices. While roles with similar names at other companies can be far more mundane, you're a creative, organized customer service specialist, who takes pride in seeing things run smoothly and efficiently. You go out of your way to make sure that clients are not only satisfied, but singing Google's praises. You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment with the highest standards of excellence. You aren't afraid to have fun with your job, and bring an enthusiasm, dedication and a collaborative spirit to build and maintain office spaces that facilitate some of the world's most cutting edge innovation.

The Global Server Operations team is responsible for monitoring the physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As a Hardware Operations Manager, you will manage a team of Data Center Technicians. You will oversee the quality installation of server hardware and components and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.

In this role, you will manage a technical team and oversee data centers and facility operations to meet organizational goals and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Key responsibilities include hiring, coaching, and developing staff, setting team priorities, and partnering with stakeholders to implement short- and long-term strategies. You will execute security and operational procedures, analyze trends for improvement, and perform preventative maintenance and repairs on equipment and infrastructure.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. title: Senior Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.

This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.

Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Senior Strategic Financial Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Financial Analysts ensure that Google makes sound financial decisions. As a Financial Analyst, your work, whether it's modeling business scenarios or tracking performance metrics, is used by our leaders to make strategic company decisions. While working on multiple projects at a time, you are focused on the details while finding creative ways to solve big picture challenges.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between external macroeconomic dynamics, competitive market movements, and commercial execution. Operating as a strategic advisor, you will synthesize complex macroeconomic signals (inflation, monetary policy, consumer sentiment, regional ad spend forecasts) and competitive share of wallet (SoW) shifts into actionable commercial intelligence. You will directly inform commercial steering, risk governance, and executive decision-making for senior leadership, including the Vice President of EMEA Global Business Organization (GBO) and the Senior Finance Director of EMEA GBO.

You are an AI-Pioneer, a skilled problem solver and an econometric thinker who thrives in ambiguity. You possess a knack for identifying emerging inflection points within multi-dimensional datasets and have the executive presence to distill sophisticated market phenomena into succinct, executive narratives. Embracing our mission to be AI-Enabled CFOs of GBO, you will harness cutting-edge Generative AI and automated ingestion workflows to analyze broker research, central bank commentary, and competitor filings at scale.

The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Translate macroeconomic data, central bank notes, and broker forecasts into commercial insights for EMEA Large Customer Sales (LCS). Provide macro scenario analysis to evaluate advertiser demand shifts across core EMEA markets.
  • Evaluate quarterly competitive dynamics across digital ad formats and cross-border disruptors. Conduct Alphabet and competitor earnings readouts highlighting market share shifts and industry growth.
  • Maintain category mapping rules and dataset integrity in Connect Sales SoW repositories. Conduct macro horizon scanning and regulatory risk sizing with Legal, GTM and Government Affairs.
  • Quantify financial exposure bounds and scenario models for Leadership Reviews. Feed macroeconomic insights into central executive storytelling and strategic narratives.
  • Perform impact sizing and diagnostics for pilots and strategic workstreams. Deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents to automate ingestion and synthesis of market research.

Preferred qualifications:
